sloka: अशोभनम् यो अहम् इह अद्य राघवम् ।दिदृक्षमाणो न लभे सलक्ष्मणम्इति इव राजा विलपन् महा यहाशःपपात तूर्णम् शयने स मूर्चितः ॥२-५९-३३॥
transliteration: aśobhanam yo aham iha adya rāghavam ।didṛkṣamāṇo na labhe salakṣmaṇamiti iva rājā vilapan mahā yahāśaḥpapāta tūrṇam śayane sa mūrcitaḥ ॥2-59-33॥

translations.english: O queen Kausalya, I am completely immersed in this ocean of sorrow. The misfortune due to Rama's separation is its breadth. Sita's separation is the other end of the shore. Sighs are its turbulent waves and whirlpools. Tears are its foam and turbid waters. Waving of arms is its fishes. Cries of agony are its roars. My dishevelled hair is its moss. Kaikeyi is the mouth of Badaba. My copious tears are its source. Words of the hunchback (Manthara) are the monstrous crocodiles. The cruel boons to Kaikeyi are its shores. Without Rama I cannot cross this sea of sorrow alive. Ah, what a pity
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार विलाग करती हुई और भूमि पर मूर्डितावस्था को प्राप्त बौसल्या बो तथा महाराज को देख, वहाँ जो अन्य रानियाँ तथा अन्तःपुर की खियाँ थीं-वे सब उञ्चस्वर से रुदन करने लगीं
